mechanics.claim: The empowered attack applies on-hit effects to the primary target it dashes to.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies along the way, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects to the primary target hit.

mechanics.claim: The dash does not count as a basic attack and does not trigger the basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Does not count as a basic attack and will not trigger any basic attack-specific interactions (e.g. {{tip|on-attack}} effects, basic attack timer, etc) unless it is special cased to do so.

mechanics.claim: The dash deals spell damage (not area damage) to the primary target, and area damage to secondary targets.
mechanics.quote: The dash deals {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown only starts after the full effect (blink and empowered attack window) resolves.
Scoring a champion takedown while the ability is active or on cooldown resets its cooldown, allowing another cast even while already active.
mechanics.quote: Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} resets the {{sti|cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell Shield can block either the blink damage or the dash damage, but not both from a single cast.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} can block either the blink damage or the dash damage, but not both.

mechanics.claim: Soul Ignition (W) can be cast during the Ashen Pursuit dash without interrupting it.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Soul Ignition|Locke}}'' can be cast during ''Ashen Pursuit's'' dash.
